Our Culinary Story

The Story of Sapna Momos

Crafted With Passion in New Usmanpura, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

From traditional Tibetan recipes to modern fusion creations like Kurkure and Pizza Momos, Sapna Momos brings authentic taste and warmth to every plate.

Authentic Tibetan Heritage

Steamed & Fried Delicacies

Handcrafted daily with fresh veggies, soft cottage paneer, and juicy minced chicken wrapped in paper-thin dough.

Exciting Fusion Specialties

Kurkure, Tandoori, Afghani & Pizza

Innovative textures including extra crunchy Kurkure batter, smoky Tandoori roast, and creamy Afghani malai glaze.

Great Value & Convenience

₹150 for Two • Free Parking

Comfortable indoor seating, takeaway, and home delivery at Shop No 6, near Dashmish Mandir, Jyoti Nagar, New Usmanpura, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra 431005.
